description: Source file implementing utility functions for media metadata processing, including codec-specific data creation for AVC and AAC, album art extraction, and Vorbis comment parsing within the Android media framework.

methods.name: MakeAVCCodecSpecificData
methods.description: Creates AVC codec-specific data and populates MetaDataBase or AMediaFormat with video parameters.

methods.name: MakeAACCodecSpecificData
methods.description: Creates AAC codec-specific data and populates MetaDataBase or AMediaFormat with audio parameters.

methods.name: extractAlbumArt
methods.description: Extracts album art image data from base64-encoded metadata and sets it in the media format.

methods.name: parseVorbisComment
methods.description: Parses Vorbis comments to extract metadata like title, artist, album, and album art.
